title: Columbian Exchange
subtitle: The 1492–1650 band and the Atlantic rows

waypoints.title: Union of the crowns, 1492
waypoints.narrative: The Age of Discovery band runs from 1492 to 1650. This stop sits on the union-of-the-crowns row, which the checklist runs from 1469 to 1516. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: New France, 1534
waypoints.narrative: New France’s checklist row starts in 1534, inside the same band. The stop uses that year. It does not add a list of crops or diseases. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Thirteen Colonies, 1607
waypoints.narrative: The Thirteen Colonies checklist row starts in 1607, still inside the 1492–1650 band. The stop uses that year. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Band end, 1650
waypoints.narrative: The discovery band ends in 1650. The VOC checklist row, started in 1602, is still current. The stop uses the band’s end and does not add a voyage. The cited page was not opened.

title: Atlantic slavery and abolition
subtitle: Checklist rows in the Atlantic centuries

waypoints.title: Songhai, 1591
waypoints.narrative: Songhai’s checklist row ends in 1591. That is the year the Saadi bridge uses. The stop does not add a count of captives. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Discovery band end, 1650
waypoints.narrative: The discovery band ends in 1650. Kongo’s checklist row is still current. This stop uses that band end. It does not add a count of captives. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Ashanti, 1701
waypoints.narrative: Ashanti’s checklist row starts in 1701. The stop uses that year. It does not date an abolition. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Haiti, 1804
waypoints.narrative: Haiti’s row uses 1804. The stop sits on that independence year. It does not add a separate abolition date. The cited page was not opened.
